source_title: @trq212 — Claude Code Channels: Control Claude Code from Telegram and Discord via MCP

discoveries.title: claude-plugins-official — Anthropic's official plugin repo for Claude Code channels
discoveries.why: Official Anthropic repo containing Telegram, Discord, and fakechat channel plugin source code. MCP-based plugin architecture for pushing events into Claude Code sessions. Directly relevant to our orchestrator — could build custom channel for orchestrator-to-agent messaging.

discoveries.title: Channels Reference — Build your own Claude Code channel
discoveries.why: Protocol specification for building custom channels. Needed to build an orchestrator channel that pushes tasks into worker agents via MCP instead of tmux send-keys.

discoveries.title: Claude Code Channels documentation
discoveries.why: Official docs page with full setup instructions, security model, enterprise controls, and comparison table. Already summarized in catalogue entry.
